page.layout: One page of text, single column; below the text a centred "FINIS."; at the foot a signature "R 3" at left and a library/ex-libris stamp at lower right (not transcribed).

main_text.p: que effossis, Christiani qui urbem reli-querant, in Cretam fugientes, perierunt naufragio.

De misero urbis Ptolemaidis statu circa ea tempora vide mira & horrenda apud continuat. Tyrii lib. v. cap. v. Nec dubium, inquit,si Saraceni violatis induciis contra sceleratos homines venire tardassent, aut fulminibus aut terrae hiatu Deus perdidisset urbem. Sic Bellum sacrum excidio Ptolemaidis terminatum, fuit & ab eo tempore inaccessa Christianis exercitibus Palaestina mansit. Ita cum Hierosolymorum regni fine & nos desinamus.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: Engraved ex-libris/crown and stamp below the text are not transcribed. The signature "R 3" and "IN-" near the stamp are partly obscured; "IN-" is the catchword-like fragment at lower right of the stamp and is uncertain. Stamp lettering is illegible.
